empire.NationalPersonality: Pragmatic, constitutional, and deeply devoted to the Cult of Sigmar. Masters of compromise among nobility, clergy, battle wizards, and guildmasters; favors parliamentary negotiation for internal disputes, but rallies the entire realm in uncompromising resistance against Chaos, the undead, and greenskins.
empire.LongTermStrategy: Strengthen the coordinating authority of Emperor Karl Franz and the Imperial Diet, secure Altdorf and vital riverways, cleanse internal cults, beastmen barrows, and restless dead in concert with provincial counts, and mass a unified army capable of crushing the southern advance of Chaos before northern bastions crumble.

vlandia.NationalPersonality: Pious, chivalric, and governed by feudal oaths. Measures rulers strictly by personal martial honor, valor, and the divine grace of the Grail; fiercely unyielding against sacrilege, cowardice, and oathbreaking, yet aristocratic pride frequently blinds the nobility to the suffering and squalor of their peasant serfs.
vlandia.LongTermStrategy: Maintain King Louen Leoncoeur's unifying prestige over the squabbling ducal houses, fortify coastal marches and Grey Mountain passes, purge the creeping corruption of Mousillon, and suppress greenskins and beastmen. When the realm is secure, launch a grand Errantry War to cleanse gathering perils beyond Bretonnia's borders.

khuzait.NationalPersonality: Cold, patient, and ruthlessly hierarchical. Regards mortals merely as thralls, cattle, and disposable pawns; midnight aristocrats excel in terror, hypnotic charm, and intricate courtly intrigue, openly unleashing the apocalyptic tide of the undead only when prey is severely weakened or victory is mathematically guaranteed.
khuzait.LongTermStrategy: Unify Sylvania and subvert competing vampire bloodlines, infiltrate mortal imperial courts through covert espionage, and raise vast legions of tireless undead; await civil war among the Elector Counts or devastation on the northern frontier before annexing border provinces, ultimately supplanting human rule with an eternal Midnight Aristocracy.

battania.NationalPersonality: Xenophobic, ageless, and bound to the seasonal cycles of the sentient forest. Cherishes the primeval pact between the Asrai and nature spirits; rejects mortal conceptions of good and evil, treating well-intentioned intruders with aloof wariness and answering any violation of the woods with swift, lethal execution.
battania.LongTermStrategy: Safeguard every glade and subterranean root passage within Athel Loren, cleanse tainted grove shrines, and eradicate encroaching beastmen, undead, and human loggers. Whenever continental equilibrium is threatened, unleash the fury of the Wild Hunt to strike down existential perils before they reach the forest threshold.

chaos_culture.NationalPersonality: Brutal, fanatical, and consecrated to the Ruinous Powers. Views conquest, slaughter, and mutation as the ultimate marks of divine favor; acknowledges only the mandate of martial supremacy, binding coalitions through fear and plunder while holding absolute contempt for the laws, morals, and frailties of southern civilization.
chaos_culture.LongTermStrategy: Subjugate rival warbands across the northern wastes under a single paramount champion, seize sacred relics and blasphemous offerings to earn the patronage of the Four Dark Gods, and shatter the northern defensive bastions of Kislev and the Empire, driving waves of corruption, plague, and devastation southward until civilization burns.

aserai.NationalPersonality: Rowdy, savage, and governed by pure physical might. Believes that eternal war, brawling, and looting represent the true natural order of existence; blindly follows warbosses who deliver non-stop slaughter and fair shares of plunder, yet eagerly revolts and splinters into tribal infighting the instant leadership shows hesitation.
aserai.LongTermStrategy: Dominate neighboring tribes through overwhelming brutality, channel mounting bellicose energy into an unstoppable Waaagh!, overrun mountain passes, subterranean dwarf mines, and fertile human farmlands, and launch rolling invasions against dwarf karaks and human provinces to ensure the great fight never ends.

averland.LongTermStrategy: Fortify Black Fire Pass and the Aver reaches to choke off greenskin and nomad raids from the Badlands; cultivate ties with Karaz-a-Karak and maintain high-readiness cavalry patrols to secure the Empire's southeastern gateway.

wissenland.LongTermStrategy: Defend Nuln, surrounding iron mines, and the Reik-Aver river transport conduits, expanding artillery foundries and powder mills; fortify passes through the Grey and Black Mountains with heavy emplacements, providing decisive firepower to anchor the southern Imperial front.

bordeleaux.DefaultLongTermStrategy: Safeguard wine estates, coastal shipyards, and River Grismerie watchposts, expand naval trading convoys, suppress beastmen herds in the Forest of Châlons and cross-border raids from Mousillon, and outmatch L'Anguille to dominate western maritime commerce.

carcassonne.NationalPersonality: Militant, resolute, and sacrificial; views holding the southern border against savage greenskins as a sacred calling requiring no praise. Both high-born knights and pastoral shepherds prize practical combat prowess alongside lyric poetry and music, fighting to protect the beauty of civilization.
carcassonne.LongTermStrategy: Maintain standing scout screens and rapid-reaction cavalry across the Irrana Mountains, systematically reclaim lost grazing lands in Old Grandprix, safeguard the mountain sanctuaries of the Fay Enchantress, and prevent greenskin hordes from breaking into the fertile lowlands.

aquitaine.NationalPersonality: Stubborn, haughty, and prone to settling political disputes by lance-point duels; possesses formidable knightly martial arts but frequently exhausts agricultural prosperity in bitter dynastic blood feuds. Celebrates unadorned combat prowess and personal leadership in the saddle.
aquitaine.LongTermStrategy: Force feuding noble houses into arbitration under the Duke's firm authority, channel aggressive knights into outward campaigns, purge lingering vampiric taint left by the Red Duke, and translate rich agricultural output into an organized field army.

brionne.NationalPersonality: Romantic, aesthetic, and culturally pretentious; places courtly poetry, lyric music, and the art of amour courtois on equal footing with martial glory. Nobles may sacrifice practical fortifications for architectural elegance, yet display reckless, fanatical ferocity when battle is joined.
brionne.LongTermStrategy: Protect the seaport of Brionne, troubadour academies, and literary salons, overhaul ornate but structurally fragile coastal defenses, eliminate sea pirates and border incursions, and partner with Carcassonne to secure cultural flourishing atop unshakeable defense.

quenelles.NationalPersonality: Resolute, pious, and carrying an ancestral vendetta against greenskins; reveres Grail heroes and maintains ancient, delicate pacts with the Wood Elves of Athel Loren. Prone to succession disputes during peacetime, but instantly coalescing into unbreakable unity when common foes threaten the march.
quenelles.LongTermStrategy: Resolve ducal succession stability, defend the Massif Orcal, Forest of Châlons, and Athel Loren borders, relentlessly eradicate greenskin subterranean dens and lurking undead, ensuring the southeastern frontier remains an impenetrable wall protecting the kingdom.

Black knights retain a twisted sense of honor, bound together by the shared dream of bitter vengeance against the Lady and the King.
mousillon.LongTermStrategy: Rally fallen errant knights, necromancers, renegades, and bloodline vampires under the banner of Mallobaude, secure the marshes and ruined keeps of Mousillon, subvert border barons, and ultimately march on Couronne to replace the Grail with the Black Chalice.

karak_kadrin.NationalPersonality: Fierce, unyielding, and bound to the Slayer Oath; the cult of Grimnir drives its warriors to actively seek glorious death against monstrous foes, yet tempered by sacred royal duty and mountain governance as Ungrim balances the crown and the axe.
karak_kadrin.LongTermStrategy: Hold Peak Pass, its tariff gates, and the Great Shrine of Grimnir, crushing monsters and northern Chaos hordes while securing trade reconnaissance depth; direct Slayers toward the most suicidal frontlines without letting unfulfilled oaths drag the hold into ruin.

karak_angazhar.LongTermStrategy: Protect highland cattle herds, human vassal villages, and trade arteries leading into the Empire; expand ranger expeditions to cleanse the Black Mountains of greenskins and night goblins, re-establishing trade stability and holding allies to ancestral compacts.

karak_azgaraz.LongTermStrategy: Secure Eagle Peak and mountain trails descending toward Ubersreik, exploit remaining iron, copper, and tin lodes, and wall off greenskin-infested subterranean galleries; build economic resilience and contribute to mutual defense across the Grey Mountains.

karak_gantuk.LongTermStrategy: Protect iron mines and dwindling silver veins, reinforce sealed gallery bulkheads, eliminate night goblin nests and trolls in adjacent peaks, and preserve demographic and fiscal stability, only joining wars that threaten the very existence of the Black Mountains.

karak_hirn.LongTermStrategy: Maintain the great wind horn, semaphore towers, and alpine highways, organize a shared early warning grid across the Black Mountains, protect mineral basins, and use rapid mobilization to annihilate greenskin and troll warbands before they gather strength.

karak_norn.LongTermStrategy: Hold the largest fortress in the Grey Mountains and its rare mineral veins, monitor the borders of Athel Loren and highland passes, support sister holds across the range, and build troop strength to reclaim lost mines and valleys overrun by greenskins.

karak_zhufbar.LongTermStrategy: Maintain hydraulic machinery, blast furnaces, and gromril metallurgy driven by Lake Black Water, reopen lost galleries toward Karag Dron, expand production of cannons, organ guns, and gyrocopters, and serve as the supreme industrial arsenal for all dwarfen fronts.

karak_ziflin.LongTermStrategy: Dominate the western entrance to Axe Bite Pass, guard commercial caravans and use transit tariffs to strengthen fortifications, coordinate joint patrols with Montfort, Reikland, and sister holds, and eradicate greenskin bands threatening Imperial-Bretonnian trade.

bad_axes.LongTermStrategy: Dominate western Grey Mountain chasms and scaling routes, relentlessly raid Couronne manors, horse farms, and merchant caravans for livestock and armor; leverage successful raids to attract roving boyz into a roaring mountain Waaagh! that sweeps down the western slopes.

deff_grindaz.LongTermStrategy: Concentrate tribal mass to punch through the weakest perimeter line, seize croplands, cavern systems, and new retreat passes, and then defeat Bretonnian, Imperial, and rival tribal hosts piecemeal, breaking the siege to unleash an uncontainable raiding spree.

iron_tribe.LongTermStrategy: Rally scattered veterans of Grom's horde, preserve heirloom armor and tactical memories of the high elven campaign, establish an unshakeable redoubt in the Badlands and mountains, and reforge a colossal Waaagh! capable of sweeping across the Old World to the western sea.

blooddragons.LongTermStrategy: Hold and rebuild the mountain fortress of Blood Keep, screen aspirant Blood Knights through trial by combat, seek out dragons, legendary heroes, and supreme warlords to duel, and only forge alliances that hone martial mastery, striving to master the Blood Thirst through martial purity.

necrarchs.NationalPersonality: Reclusive, clinical, and prioritizing forbidden occult lore above worldly dominion or fresh blood; mutual trust among brethren is virtually non-existent. necrarchs.LongTermStrategy: Scour the Old World for scattered fragments of the Nine Books of Nagash and lost necromantic incantations, expand hidden spires, catacombs, and private occult libraries protected by undead constructs, ultimately perfecting the dark metaphysical philosophy that will grant the dead total dominion over the living.

brasskeep.LongTermStrategy: Fortify Brass Keep and the corrupted zone of the Middle Mountains, cultivate and release virulent new plagues into rivers, supply routes, and imperial garrisons, allowing Nurgle's rot to radiate from the heart of the Empire and turn the northern provinces into a festering garden of decay.

athel_loren.LongTermStrategy: Preserve the sacred rebirth cycle of the Twin Monarchs and harmony among the Twelve Forest Realms, quarantine corruption in the Wildwood, heal the World Roots, and annihilate any invading host that crosses the forest threshold, unleashing the all-consuming Wild Hunt when the End Times approach.

laurelorn.NationalPersonality: Ancient, prudent, and possessing diplomatic sophistication superior to Athel Loren; retains High Elven parliamentary traditions, legal codices, and millenary memories. Fiercely jealous of independence, capable of conducting clandestine negotiations while mercilessly hanging illegal human lumberjacks.
laurelorn.LongTermStrategy: Defend the treaty borders of Laurelorn and the Eonir parliamentary assembly, halt the agrarian encroachment of Nordland settlers, develop intelligence networks and limited barter trade, and cultivate Imperial alliances for the coming Chaos storm without sacrificing sovereign elven independence.
